thread.label: Genesis 3:1
thread.text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

precepts.label: Job 26:13
precepts.why:
When did the war start? Through the envy of the devil, when he made his move on Adam’s kingdom. And he made that move through Adam’s wife: “Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made.”

The serpent is Satan, the devil. It says serpent, but it is not talking about a snake; he is called a serpent because he is slick, forked-tongued, tricky. And notice, “which the Lord God had made.” God created him to be exactly who he is. He was subtil because God made him subtil.

Job confirms it: “By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.” God formed that crooked serpent, Satan. He is not a rival power that rose up on his own to equal God; he is a creature God made, crooked by design.

So Satan tricked Eve, the weaker vessel, and caused her to sin, and Eve went and convinced her husband to sin. Then the Most High came to deal with Adam, Eve and Satan, and brought judgment on all three. From there God declared the war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”.

That is why we have to know our adversary. The serpent that deceived Eve is the same one we fight today, in his whispers and in his children, and the one who formed him is the one who will judge him.

thread.label: Genesis 3:14-15

precepts.label: Luke 4:5-6
precepts.why:
Satan made his move on Adam through the weaker vessel, and God brought judgment on the serpent, the woman and the man. To the serpent: “Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field”. That is not about livestock. This is paradise; he is cursed above every creation God made there. And, “upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life”.

That one line says two things. Man was made from the earth, and Satan is a celestial being, so “all the days of thy life” means his days are numbered: he will be destroyed in the future for what he did. And eating dust means he is on the earth, and the Lord handed him power over it.

Luke shows it: “the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” When was the power of this earth delivered to Satan? In Genesis 3, what we just read.

And he gave it to whom he would: first to Cain, and then to Esau, the so-called white man in these last days. That is why Esau is able to create all this technology.

Then comes the declaration of war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. Back then her seed was Abel, then Seth and the chosen lineage, and Satan’s seed was Cain and his descendants. Today her seed is the twelve tribes of Israel, and his seed is the so-called Caucasians, Edom. And “it shall bruise thy head”, because his seed, the Romans, crucified Christ. Then, “and thou shalt bruise his heel”: the Lord will take down Satan and his children. So when the Bible says to be soldiers of Jesus Christ, we fight Satan, his wicked thoughts and whispers, and we also fight his children, his physical counterpart.

precepts.label: Job 1:6-7
precepts.why:
“Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.” Satan does not run around doing his own thing. He goes before the Lord and answers to him.

“And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.” That walking up and down in the earth is the dust he eats. In Genesis 3 God said, “upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life”. Here is that judgment being lived out: his job is to walk the earth to see whom he can tempt and destroy. Satan became the tempter, and that is his judgment; soon he will be destroyed.

It happened after Satan was judged, and it shows the order of things. The power of this world was delivered to him, but he still presents himself before the Lord and reports where he has been.

The word Satan comes from a Hebrew term meaning adversary: accuser, opponent. And the word devil means deceiver. He is the Lord’s adversary and our adversary. And not only the spiritual Satan: his seed, his children, are our adversary too, because God put enmity between his seed and her seed. The so-called white man is our adversary, and the spiritual demon Satan is our adversary. That is the war we are in.

precepts.label: 1 John 3:12
precepts.why:
Genesis 4 shows Satan’s children being born in the earth. Eve bare Cain and then Abel; Abel kept sheep and Cain tilled the ground. “And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth”. The Lord told him, “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.” Do good and you will be accepted; do evil and Satan will rule over you. Cain would become the child of Satan and serve him.

Then Cain talked with Abel, “and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him”. That is the fulfillment of Genesis 3:15, “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. The enmity started there. Cain, Satan’s seed, killed our forefather: the first murder on the earth and the first blood shed in the war.

John proves Cain was that seed: “Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.” Cain was always evil. His descendants were the children of the devil, and they corrupted everyone on the earth, even the sons of God, until God destroyed the world. All the evil you see Esau doing on the earth today, Cain was doing back then.

Then the sons of God and the sons of the devil came back. Rebekah’s children “struggled together within her”, and the Lord said, “Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels”. Jacob is the twelve tribes, the so-called Negroes and Hispanics; Esau is the so-called white man. This fight did not start with slavery, Jim Crow or civil rights; it started in the beginning with Cain and Abel, and was reborn as Jacob and Esau: good against evil. Many of our people followed Cain then, and many follow Esau now and have become children of the devil themselves.

Esau “came out red, all over like an hairy garment”, born without pigment, as Cain lost his when the earth cursed him. Jacob took hold on his heel, a prophetic sign of Genesis 3:15: our Lord coming to destroy Satan and his children. And when scripture says “the devil shall cast some of you into prison”, it was Herod, an Edomite, who “killed James the brother of John with the sword” and took Peter. The devil means the deceiver, and it is interchangeable: the father and his children, who can do nothing without the father that dwells in them.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:43-44
precepts.why:
Exodus 1:11 says “they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens.” Deuteronomy 28 names that as a curse: “The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low. He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.”

The strangers are the people that were amongst us. They get above us very high, and we come down very low. To be above us means they rule and tell us what to do, and another name for that is taskmaster.

That curse was on us in ancient Egypt: the Egyptians were over us, and we were on the bottom of society. It is the same way the so-called white man and the nations are above us today, and we are the bottom of society. The taskmasters today are the governors, the politicians, the police officers, the FBI agents, people set to keep us in check and keep us in order, with laws like Jim Crow and the black codes to keep us low. On the cotton field there was always a white overseer to make sure we did the work, or you got your ass whooped. Today your taskmaster is your boss.

What was done to us in ancient Egypt is what was done to us in America. That is why this place is spiritually called Egypt.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:30
precepts.why:
“And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.” We built cities in ancient Egypt, and it is the same thing here in America. Deuteronomy 28:30 lists it among the curses: “Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.”

In ancient Egypt we built cities and houses, and we did not build them for ourselves; we built them for the Egyptians. We were a commodity, and they did not look at us as human. America did the same.

What house did we build here in America and could not dwell in it? The White House. Construction began in 1792 in Washington D.C., and hundreds of enslaved people rented from plantation owners quarried the stone, cut the timber and laid the bricks, dawn to dusk, with no wages, whipped if they slowed down. Most are not even named in the records, just negro hired. When it was finished in 1800 and President Adams moved in, the enslaved workers were sent back to the plantations with no credit and no freedom, and for the next 65 years more enslaved people worked there. Some of you thought the white man built that.

We built cities in Egypt and did not dwell in them, and we built the White House and cannot dwell in it. The same curse, in ancient Egypt and in spiritual Egypt.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:16
precepts.why:
Exodus 1:14 says “they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field”. We were in the fields in ancient Egypt; we were not just building pyramids. They had us doing plantation work and cropping there too. Deuteronomy 28:16 is that curse: “Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.”

The same way ancient Egypt made us slaves and worked us in the fields with all manner of service, in America that curse also fell upon us. We were cursed in the cotton field, in the sugar cane field, in the tobacco field, with five year olds and two year olds picking cotton. Our lives were made bitter, and that is why we eat the bitter herbs at Passover: they represent our lives being bitter in Egypt.

And all manner of service: we were their servants, cooking their food, watching their kids, entertaining them. Sing, this Hebrew got a good voice, sing me one of the songs of Zion. That is what we do here in Babylon. Some of you drive a bus, fix the road, drive a taxi cab: servant jobs, and you don't see it. We have been slaves so long we got comfortable with the jobs they give us. We are kings and priests; we are not supposed to serve any nation. Our job is to serve God.

Read the curses of Deuteronomy 28 and then read what happened to us in ancient Egypt, and you will see they are the same. America is spiritual Egypt.

precepts.label: Leviticus 26:17
precepts.why:
Exodus 1:12 says “the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.” No matter how much they afflicted us, we kept multiplying and growing. And what does it mean that the Egyptians were grieved because of us? They were mad; they were angry.

Leviticus 26:17 explains it: “And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.” To be grieved because of the children of Israel means they hated us, and they that hated us reigned over us.

The same way the ancient Egyptians hated us, the so-called white man hated us when we were brought here as slaves. So “the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour”: they did not play with us. In ancient Egypt they beat the hell out of us with whips, and in America the same: runaways caught and whooped, lynchings, and still lynching us. Not only America but all the lands we were scattered into are Egypt, but this is the main one, Mystery Babylon.

precepts.why:
Pharaoh told the Hebrew midwives, “if it be a son, then ye shall kill him”. Where is that in Deuteronomy? “Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land”. What is the fruit of our body? Our children. That is why it says our children are going to be cursed.

In ancient Egypt, when the baby came out, Pharaoh commanded the midwives to kill it if it was a male. That is oppression. Today they do the same thing, and it is called abortion.

And how do they get rid of the males today? The school to prison pipeline. They create conditions for our people to live in poverty, bring drugs into the community, and when the brothers are out there selling, they put them away for the rest of their lives. That whole system was set up by Esau. That is them dealing wisely, “let us deal wisely with them.” And through the vaccines: when you look at the rate of autism in young black and Hispanic men, it is very high. They put things in the vaccines to mess with the babies' minds. But Esau has been mixing with us, so some of our DNA is in theirs, and now white people complain that their kids are coming out with autism too.

It goes back to the scripture that says they try to destroy the poor secretly. Secretly they try to kill every male child amongst us, because they are trying to stop the prophets from coming on the earth. What Pharaoh did in ancient Egypt, America is doing in spiritual Egypt.

precepts.label: Isaiah 31:1-2
precepts.why:
The Lord is a man of war, and his vengeance is on all the nations read in Psalms 83; he has a big payback coming for all of them. Egypt is one example. Exodus 15 says “Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea”, and Isaiah 31 shows what all that power was worth: “Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong”.

Did the power help them? No. All their chariots and all their war materials did not help them at all. And “they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!” We did not look to the Holy One of Israel, to our God, to save us. The God of Israel is the only God that is going to save us out of all this foolishness. The wars are going to come to the point where thermonuclear ICBMs are put in full effect and a lot of people die, and the question to ask yourself is, will it be us?

“Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words”. He is not calling back his word. Evil is set for all these nations, and these nations will be destroyed. Where will you be? You cannot have God to trust in and Christ coming to save you while you sit in confederacy with all these nations, thinking all nations are going to be saved and we are all together. That is not the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

So the right hand that “hath dashed in pieces the enemy” in Exodus 15:6 is the same hand that will overthrow every nation Israel trusts in instead of him.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 51:13-14
precepts.why:
Prophecy is coming to pass and there is no stopping it. The wild and crazy ones made demands to the proud one: not only fall back out of our country, but pay us back for all the destruction. The proud man says no, we are not going to do that. Even while they talk about peace talks, God has them in the trick bag.

“O thou that dwellest upon many waters”: that is New Babylon, America. She is “abundant in treasures”: rich from all the nations, because they have taken all the land and all the resources and oppressed all the people. And “thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.” The Most High is already telling her that her end is come and it is time to step down. She is not going to step down, so God is going to put her down.

“The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself”: the same Lord of hosts who is a man of war in Exodus 15:3. “Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.” Those caterpillars are the wild and crazy ones.

If proud Babylon gives in to the demands, she loses her sovereignty over the economy, and that is her downfall. Because she is prideful and already in power, she will not do it, so it leads to war, and God activates the caterpillars. Either way it goes to war. As the Lord cast Pharaoh's chariots into the sea, he will consume this enemy as stubble.

thread.label: Leviticus 17:11
thread.text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

precepts.label: Romans 5:10-11
precepts.why:
Leviticus says what the blood is for: “it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.” Paul shows whose blood: “For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.” When we were breaking God's law, we became his enemies. Being reconciled now, by Christ's life we are going to be saved.

“And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.” The blood of Christ is what gave us the atonement, so that we can build upon grace. The blood of Christ is more powerful than the animal sacrifice; it is the most powerful thing in this universe.

Read on in the chapter: “For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.” By one man's offence death came into the world because of sin, and it reigned from then until today; look at our condition. “For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.”

That is the platform we have now. The platform we had under the one man's sin, we got messed up on. But Christ did it right this time, so we can build upon him and do it right because he did it right. It is through mercy we make it to the door, because our righteousness is as filthy rags; so nobody should be boasting of how perfect he is. Christ did not come for the righteous; he came for the sick, so he could heal them. And “in bringing many sons unto glory”, his death brings many sons into glory: a new body and a new mindset. So keep on trying, keep on working, and don't give up.

precepts.label: Ephesians 5:2
precepts.why:
“And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.” Christ gave himself as a sacrifice for us. His blood on the altar is the atonement Leviticus speaks of: “I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls”.

Likewise, we are going to have to do the same thing for our brothers and our sisters. We have to become their sacrifice. Many don't pay attention to this: when they put you to death out here, the Lord looks at it as a sacrifice. That is why it is said that in Babylon they see your altar. What did they do on the altar? Offer blood sacrifice. They are going to put us to death out here, and that is what the altar represents.

We are unto God “a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish”. The ones who walk the other way are the ones who “in time past” walked “according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience”. Those children of disobedience are in the churches, in the mosques, in everything, thinking that is the way. Satan works in them because they keep no commandment. The way is through God's law, statutes and commandments, to his son Jesus the Christ.

So walking in love is walking as Christ walked: keeping the commandments, and giving ourselves for our people as he gave himself, an offering the Lord receives as a sweetsmelling savour.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
In the wilderness the children of Israel wept and said, “We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick”. What are they saying? Deuteronomy 28:48 explains it.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Serving our enemies in hunger and in thirst is one of the curses that was upon us, and it was also a curse that was on us in ancient Egypt. We had to serve the Egyptians for the want of all things. It is the same today: you need money to buy food, and you have to serve for it.

Back then we had fish, because the Nile was abundant in fish, and we had melons. So brothers got delivered from oppression and started talking about going back to Egypt: even though we were oppressed, at least there we had some good food. It is the same thing with us here in America. A lot of you have food, you are full, you are comfortable. Well, for now.

precepts.label: Leviticus 18:3
precepts.why:
It was not just that the Egyptians fed us. Everything we learned, we learned from the Egyptians back then. So when we came out of Egypt, God said: “After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do”.

Why did God say not to do after the doings of Egypt? Because we learned the Egyptian customs while we were there, the Egyptian names of the week. It is the same way here in America: you talk about Monday and Tuesday and all of that, days named after their gods, and all that is idolatry.

So God says, everything you learned in Egypt, forget it. The people who longed for the fish and the melons of Egypt were still holding on to Egypt in their hearts. And it is going to be the same thing when we are delivered up out of here, out of spiritual Egypt: everything we learned from this land, we will have to leave behind.

precepts.label: Sirach 26:19-21
precepts.why:
“Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds: lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown, and the fruit of thy vineyard, be defiled.” Reading that, we might think only of agriculture or farming, but it is talking about much more than that, and Sirach 26 shows what.

“My son, keep the flower of thine age sound; and give not thy strength to strangers.” The strangers are the heathen, the other nations. Then it explains how you give your strength to them: “When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed.” A fruitful possession means you have a position, you have money, you are rich. Sow it with your own seed means sow it with your own people. You got money? Don't be going and marrying no damn white woman. What a lot of brothers do today, the first thing when they get money, is go marry a heathen. When you marry the heathen when you are rich, you are giving your strength unto strangers.

Instead, deal with your own people: start a family with the woman God created for you, “trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” Your stock is your nationality, your race, your people. You are a son of God; why would you want to go deal with other nations?

“So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.” When you marry your sisters and bring forth children among your people, your children and your race are magnified. Good descent means your children are not confused about what their nationality is, because you did not sow your seed among all different kinds of heathen women, as our forefathers did in the book of Nehemiah.

That is the law of Deuteronomy 22:9. When we go and deal with other nations, the fruit of the vineyard is defiled: the children brought forth, the descendants, are defiled and confused.

precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 28:15 says that if we will not hearken unto the voice of the Lord to do all his commandments and his statutes, “all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”. Verse 27 names one of them: “The Lord will smite thee with the botch of Egypt”. Then verse 60: “Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.”

That is what we need to see. The curses of Deuteronomy 28 did not just come out of nowhere. A lot of them are the same curses that were on us in ancient Egypt: the botch of Egypt, the diseases of Egypt, the oppression of Egypt. God said in Exodus 3:9, “I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.” Our forefathers were oppressed in ancient Egypt, and they were oppressed here in America, and are still being oppressed here. The oppression is real.

So when the scripture calls America spiritually Egypt, it is because the same things that happened to us in ancient Egypt happened to us here, and the curses show it. The diseases of Egypt cleave unto us in this land, along with the rest: we grope at noonday, we do not prosper in our ways, and as a nation of people we are only oppressed and spoiled evermore.

precepts.label: Exodus 14:13
precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 28:68 says “the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again”. Moses is being very specific, and Exodus 14:13 explains it. At the Red Sea he told the people: “Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.”

The scripture already said we would never see those Egyptians again, for ever. So when Moses says we will go into Egypt a second time, the Egypt he is speaking of cannot be ancient Egypt. The people would have said, Egypt again? We are going back to Egypt a second time? And he explains: I am not talking about the Egypt you just came out of. The way whereof I speak unto thee, thou shalt see it no more again. It is a different Egypt.

And this time we go into it with ships. Moses saw the end. The Lord showed him the Israelites thrown on cargo slave ships and brought here to America: the transatlantic slave trade. Egypt, from the Hebrew Mizraim, means shut in, restraint, misery, tribulation, distress. So going into Egypt again means going into captivity, misery and tribulation again, carried there on ships, sold to our enemies for bondmen and bondwomen. That is why Revelation 11:8 calls the great city, Mystery Babylon, America, spiritually Egypt.

precepts.label: Isaiah 66:22-24
precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 29:22 speaks of “the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you”. Who is that? Isaiah 66 shows it: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.” The seed and the name that remain in the new heaven and new earth are the righteous of our people that make it, those of us that get the kingdom.

“And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.” After they come up to worship, “they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me”. Go forth where? To look on this place, America. That is the same moment Deuteronomy 29 describes, when the generation to come and the stranger from a far land see the plagues of that land, “brimstone, and salt, and burning”, and ask, “Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land?”

After somebody dies, their carcase is supposed to just disappear. So this is letting you know it is something spiritual. “for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.” They are in damnation, cast in hell, being tormented. That is why Deuteronomy 29 says the Lord will separate the man that did not repent unto evil.

There is a place of torment, and it will be set up when Christ returns. After this place is destroyed physically, a spiritual prison and damnation will be set up here, the place of torment for the devils that said, have you come to torment us before our time. Christ has the power over hell and death: he can give you life and immortality, or wake you up and torment you.

precepts.label: Daniel 12:2
precepts.why:
Christ has the power over life and death, which is why Daniel 12 says some shall awake. “And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.”

Many of them are going to awake. Some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt. When you die, you go to sleep, yes. But Christ has the power to wake your behind up and torment you.

That is what stands behind the carcases of Isaiah 66:24, whose worm does not die and whose fire is not quenched, and behind the land of Deuteronomy 29 that is all brimstone, salt and burning. Those who forsook the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers and served other gods do not simply die and disappear: they are awakened to shame and everlasting contempt. As 2 Esdras 9 says, read in the same moment, those who despised his law while the place of repentance was open “must know it after death by pain.” And the righteous awake to everlasting life, the seed and the name that remain.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 4:26-27
precepts.why:
In Deuteronomy 31 Moses says, “For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves”, and “evil will befall you in the latter days”. How is Moses able to say I know? Deuteronomy 4 shows what he saw.

“I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.” When we went into the land of Israel, our days were not going to be prolonged in it; we were going to be destroyed from off that land. “And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you.” Moses saw the Israelites being scattered throughout the four corners of the earth.

He could see it because God showed it to him. In 2 Esdras 14, read right after, the Lord says, “In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself unto Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt”, and he held him on the mount a long season, the forty days and forty nights, and “shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end”. Moses saw the secrets of the beginning, which is how he wrote Genesis, and he saw the end.

So Moses saw what would happen to us in the time of the Babylonians, the Greeks and the Romans, and he saw us here in America, in the transatlantic slave trade, and America being destroyed. That is why he could say with certainty that evil would befall us in the latter days: he had already seen it.

precepts.label: Joshua 2:15-16
precepts.why:
When the king of Jericho sent for the men, Rahab hid them “with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof”, and sent the pursuers the wrong way. Then she went further: “Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.” “And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.”

She not only helped the prophets, she helped them with an exit. She gave them a way out and a plan: where to go, how long to hide, and when it would be safe to go their way.

These examples are in here for our learning. In these last days some brothers and sisters are going to be looked to to hide the prophets. As we build this spiritual underground railroad, some of y'all will be required to help one another, and sometimes when you help brothers and sisters you are going to put yourself in danger.

Is that you, sister? Is that you, brother? Are you ready to do that for your nation? Or are you going to sell out to keep this body that gets a headache, gets diarrhea, gets belly aches, coughing and all kind of infirmities? The scriptures tell you we have to be ready in these last days.

That is why Hebrews 13 follows it: “Let brotherly love continue.” “Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.” Start small, in your household. Make that guest room ready to receive a guest; if you can't afford an extra room, instead of buying that leather couch, get a pullout couch. If a prophet is on the run and you can provide shelter for two days, a meal and shelter for a prophet, that is a blessing for you. That is the mindset of Rahab, and the mindset we have to have in these last days.

precepts.label: Job 42:5-6
precepts.why:
Job ends where chapter 32 began. There the three men ceased to answer him “because he was righteous in his own eyes”, and Elihu was angry “because he justified himself rather than God.” Here Job says, “I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee. Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

Job hated himself and repented. He repented for justifying himself and not God, for being righteous in his own eyes. He had said, I am righteous, this is not supposed to happen to me; I made a covenant with mine eyes, I don't look at other women, I am not weak like Adam, I don't hide sin in my bosom. That was his flaw. He was over-righteous, and the Lord did not like it.

In his own eyes Job did not look at it as though there was a reason God was doing this, that God was trying to make him better. In his mind it was, I am righteous, I am not like this person or that person. So the Bible says, “Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?” That person who tries to act over-righteous just ends up looking fake; nobody knows everything and nobody is perfect.

This is the war within, the war nobody sees. Everything Job suffered before was physical, but Satan was attacking his mind too. The Lord used what Job went through to show him what was inside himself, and that is what Satan's attacks do: they show you things inside yourself. Through all of it Job was made perfect, and he came out of it repenting in dust and ashes, justifying God instead of himself.

All the things Trump is doing, and ICE is doing in the streets and in the black community, are God opening your ears. For the last 60 years our people have been lost and confused, following the American dream and thinking America is about equal rights and opportunity. God said, no, this place is not your rest. So he turns up the oppression, because that is the only time we as a people turn to God: when bad things start happening to us.

Hosea says it: “I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.” Until we acknowledge our offence and seek God's face.

In our affliction we will seek him early: before it is too late, before we die, before judgment comes. Our people are realizing that the American dream is exactly what it is, a dream, and that there is no such thing here as justice and equal rights. That is why judgment must begin first at the house of the Lord. Number one, for us to turn back to our God. Number two, to prove us: as you turn to him, bad things will happen to see whether you believe and trust in him. “And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.” He is the one who will redeem us from the condition we are in.

And Isaiah 30 gives the teachers their job: though the Lord gives the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, the teachers will not be removed into a corner any more. As our people cry under the affliction, we go to them and tell them why it is happening: this is the way, walk ye in it. Not guns, as some are calling for; the word of God is what will change our people and bring destruction on this place.

precepts.label: Psalms 37:32
precepts.why:
Esau “hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.” The white man's mouth is full of cursing, deceit and fraud. “He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent”: that is Mossad and the CIA, the black sites where they would put us and kill us. And “his eyes are privily set against the poor”: the eye on the back of the dollar bill, and the social media and technology set up to monitor us. Every porn video you watch, every site you go on, the white man knows. The ADL monitors bank accounts, and even the police can see all that information. Everything is coming under one system.

With the system they have set up they can tell everything you are doing. They are watching those of us who keep the commandments, who call ourselves Israelites. They know there are more than a million people in America who identify as Israelites and agree with these teachings.

And they seek to slay him: they want to destroy us. “He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor.” He wants to catch you slipping, clicking on the wrong thing. “He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones”: the government, the police, the military.

So walk right and be an example. Build yourselves up. If the wicked is watching the righteous, let him find nothing on you but the commandments of God.

precepts.label: Psalms 56:5-6
precepts.why:
The wicked sits in the secret places and “his eyes are privily set against the poor.” David describes how they watch: “Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil. They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.”

They mark your steps: they watch everywhere you go. When you download TikTok now, you have to agree to terms that let them check your immigration status and follow your location wherever you go. The new terms are set up to monitor you and follow you. They want to destroy our soul.

Christ went through the same thing: “And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.” They watch us through these devices; even YouTube lets our channels stay up so they can monitor us. And they send spies who act righteous and act like they want to learn, sent by the federal government to set us up, plant something and lie on us, as they did in France, where conversations among the brothers showed up in the court case against a brother put out of the country.

That is why anything you say has to be scriptural; none of you should be saying dumb, stupid stuff, because they are waiting to wrest your words and deliver them to the government. And the one who takes that work for a little house and a little bank account condemns his soul forever. But the Lord “disappointeth the devices of the crafty”, and “he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth”: from the lies of their media.

precepts.label: Psalms 51:11
precepts.why:
Solomon was knocked down, and David, the man after the Lord's own heart, was knocked down. Did they stay down? No. We are not in the business of staying down; we get knocked down and keep going. Satan tells us to stay down, and some brothers and sisters want you to stay down, but that is not what God said. “The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.” That is what God is looking for.

So what do we pray when Satan knocks us down? David prayed it: “Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.” We pray that the Lord does not remove his Holy Spirit from us, because that is what keeps us standing.

“Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.” You have to look at the truth with a joyful and glad heart, because you cannot live without it; it is part of your system, your life. Where else can you go? We do not give up our position; we pray that the Lord keeps strengthening us.

“Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.” When we get back up, our job is to teach, because we have been through the trial and tribulation and understand what it takes. We go right back to the business we left off, teaching our people their transgressions so they do not fall into what we fell into. Do we give that up to go sit on the couch, or sit in the back and puff up on evil?

Nobody sees the prayer, the crying at night, the tears when you are home alone thinking, I could have done better. That is the broken and contrite heart God will not despise. Tell Satan to bring it on. With a position or without it, be the same: a trooper. And when a brother is knocked down, do not applaud it; fast and pray for him, because he is still fighting the same battle you are, and your sin may just not be revealed as quickly as his.

When somebody lies on you or slanders you, what that really says is that there is hatred there. The lying lips are hiding hatred.

“and he that uttereth a slander”: you had Tyre Gas, you had Lightfoot, you had these guys uttering slanders, and their followers talk that way because their leaders are the same way. They run with slander. As a leader you are supposed to hear an outrageous lie and say, I do not believe that. One woman said we came to Canada on a magic school bus, and some leaders believed it.

God says you are a fool to listen to lies, run with them and put them out there. Slander is defamation: running with an accusation without two or three witnesses, and God cuts that man off.

precepts.label: Proverbs 26:28
precepts.why:
“A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.” If you lie on somebody and run with slander, it says that you hate the one who is afflicted by it.

You heard it plainly from one of them: I am here to down IUIC. That is the hatred behind the lying tongue that Psalms 101 says God will cut off.

Every matter is to be established by two or three witnesses. What was put out about Captain Obadiah was one witness, and that witness was a lie. The charges were dropped; the footage and the witnesses showed he was defending himself. It is sad that the white man had to come and say he was defending himself, when those who talk about righteous judgment could not understand something that simple. In London, when our sister died, people said IUIC killed her and hid evidence, and the investigators showed that the man who did it was evil and we had nothing to do with it.

A false witness is called slander, or defamation, and false witness can get you killed. By the law, what was to be done to the brother you slandered is to be done unto you. We do not have power to institute that, but Esau’s court system has defamation, and that is how it is going to be done now: whatever you put out against the truth, you had better be able to prove it, or you will have to come up out of the pockets. That is to protect the ministry of Christ, because the lies are put out to blame the ministry.

precepts.label: Sirach 11:9

“Strive not in a matter that concerneth thee not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.” That is why so many brothers get caught up in suits: striving in things that do not concern them, things they know nothing about. You just hear something and you are running your mouth.

To sit in judgment with sinners is sitting in counsel with brothers that are not right, brothers who were put out of the school, like Judah Mack and Titus.

Read on: “My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent.” This is for those who keep running their mouths talking about us. You meddle in matters that do not concern you, and you are not going to be innocent. That is why legal measures are being taken: to teach men to control their mouths, and to make sure that when you say something, it is true.

So the privy slanderer of Psalms 101 is the man who strives in what does not concern him and sits with sinners, and God will cut him off.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 15:28-30
precepts.why:
Isaiah says, “Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.” Before the 70s Iran was always known as Persia; that is the Medes and Persians, the second of Daniel's beasts counting from Babylon. God is going to stir them up against the United States of America, Babylon, and all the bombs, the warfare and the destroying of their economy that America and Israel are doing is what will make them rise up. They will not care about money or gold.

“Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.” They will even kill children. That is the third woe: it starts in the land of Israel and ends with America destroyed. “And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms” … “shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” That is nuclear destruction.

Ezra shows who sets it off: “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” The dragons of Arabia are the Arabs, the sons of Ishmael. They are the ones who will fully set it off, with the Israelis in the land over there. It will not be Iran first.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood.” The Carmanians are Iran, the Persians. Why are they raging in wrath? Because of all the oppression, the sanctions, the bombing of their cities, the killing of their leaders. In the following years Iran will be under heavy sanctions and bombed a lot by the United States, and America and Israel are trying to back a coup against the Iranian regime. Everything Trump is doing is just fulfilling Bible prophecy: he is making the Persians mad.

We don't give a crap about the Arabs or the Iranians. Those people enslaved us, and God is bringing judgment on them. America is the hammer of God, and God is using America to judge the Arabs and the Persians. Then in the end that same cup America is pouring on them is going to be poured on America.

America is about to turn up affliction on everyone on this earth, including us, and it will get worse and worse, like a woman in travail. So this is not the time to be in la-la land or in the midst of sin. It is the time to prepare ourselves and get our spirit right for what is about to take place.

precepts.label: Joel 2:15-20
precepts.why:
Isaiah says “they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors.” What will the oppressors be doing? The same thing 2 Esdras 16, Revelation 12:17, Matthew 10 and Matthew 24 say: Jacob's trouble. Joel shows the crying.

“Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts.” This is going to be a major fast, because there will be so much devastation to our people. “Let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet”: when this fast goes out, we are not doing weddings or planning weddings. Weddings are finished. We have to pray to the Lord because our people are dying.

“Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord.” That is the cry of Isaiah 19, crying bitterly because there is going to be death. “And give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?”

“Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people.” He answers, “I will send you corn, and wine, and oil” and “I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen: But I will remove far off from you the northern army.” That is the great multitude after us in 2 Esdras 16. He will “drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea.” The east sea is the Dead Sea and the utmost sea is the Mediterranean: the land of Israel between them, what they call the Middle East. The Lord is going to cause things to pop off there.

“And his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.” The Lord is going to destroy them over there: tribulation, World War III, Armageddon. It is all laid out for us. Yes, you are dying, but you are not dead; the Lord takes the northern army down, and then he sends us “a saviour, and a great one”, Christ, to deliver us.

“The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.” The ships in the Red Sea are going to hear about this fall.

“Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah.” Bozrah is Jordan, that area on the map. That is how the Lord takes the northern army down over there, while he tells us, don't worry, you are dying but you are not dead. Jacob's trouble is great, “but he shall be saved out of it.”

“Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin.” Our people take counsel, but not of God. Our people made that covenant in 1964 and 1965 with civil rights, the Voting Rights Act and integration, and Martin Luther King understood it at the end when he said he had integrated his people into a burning house. Our forefathers did the same with Rome, the gates of hell, when they said we have no king but Caesar, and they were destroyed in 70 AD. It is the same state of mind today: our people love voting for US presidents and trust in this system. But Isaiah 28:18 says “your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand”, and after sixty years it is falling apart before our eyes.

precepts.label: Revelation 18:4
precepts.why:
“I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.” The Lord gave other nations for us: he brought blood and destruction on their heads on our behalf. “Since thou wast precious in my sight”, not yellow, black and white all precious in his sight like the Christian song says, but the twelve tribes, “therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.” He didn't say he would spare the little Arab kids or the Israeli kids planted in the land. Revelation shows how much he loves us in the middle of that.

He has put it in front of us in prophecy: what is about to go down, where it is going down, who is involved and who is conspiring against Israel, and the parts they will play. He has told us not to meddle with them, and he has told us what to do to secure our salvation.

“And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people.” Who are his people? According to Isaiah 3:12, children are their oppressors and women rule over them; only the southern kingdom and northern kingdom have that problem. So he is letting you know it is only Israel.

“That ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Don't be part of the sins and the plagues coming on this place, the land of the north where Esau dwells, or in the valley of decision where everybody is gathering for the great day of Armageddon. Don't receive the death and destruction on the way when the Most High shows up.

So your fight is not with the nations. Your fight is with getting yourself together, working on your salvation, so you can see the promise made to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

precepts.label: Isaiah 3:12
precepts.why:
Isaiah 43 says, “Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee.” Who is the “thee” the Lord loves and gives other nations for? Revelation 18 says “Come out of her, my people”, and Isaiah 3 identifies who his people are.

“As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them.” There is only one people with that problem: the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom, Israel. We are the only ones living under it.

So “my people” is Israel, not all nations. The fools who want to engraft all the nations say, what about all nations? But if you acknowledge that we are the twelve tribes of Israel and still want to engraft every other nation in, when are you going to acknowledge that they have to give us back our land and everything that belongs to us? You won't. It's hypocrisy.

The Lord has not dealt with any other nation. “Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory”, and “Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord.” All the destruction coming on the other nations is to set the twelve tribes of Israel, those keeping the commandments and striving, back in their rightful place.

precepts.label: Isaiah 8:20
precepts.why:
“Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses.” Who can show the things from the past? The next verse answers: “Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen.” God’s witnesses on this earth are the children of Israel, and the two sticks, the stick of Judah and the stick of Ephraim, the southern and northern kingdoms, are two witnesses also.

What does a witness have? A testimony. A witness testifies, like a witness to a crime in a court of law. And we do not play a small role. Isaiah shows what God’s witnesses testify: “To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.”

As witnesses, what we are supposed to be testifying is the law and the testimony. If they do not speak according to this word, the law and the testimony, there is no light in them.

The testimony is what John bore record of: “the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.” Part of that testimony is to identify “them which say they are Jews, and are not”, the synagogue of Satan. And Malachi’s testimony: “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness.” The they who call them that are the witnesses, the prophets. So when the nations are gathered and asked for witnesses, Israel stands to the law and to the testimony.

precepts.label: Sirach 36:14
precepts.why:
“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord.” A witness has a testimony. What is the testimony Israel carries? Sirach shows where it came from: “Fill Sion with thine unspeakable oracles, and thy people with thy glory: Give testimony unto those that thou hast possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in thy name.”

The testimonies are what God gave to Moses, to Jeremiah, to Nahum, to Micah, to Isaiah, to Peter, Paul and the apostles. All the things these men wrote are the testimony: testimonies of things that are going to happen in the future, of what is going to happen to the children of Israel.

So when the scripture says the witnesses have to testify, the testimony is what is written, what the prophets said is going to happen. That is why Isaiah 43:9 asks “who among them can declare this, and shew us former things?” No other nation can. Israel, the people God possessed from the beginning, was given the unspeakable oracles, and we testify them.

And as we testify, we bring forth judgment. Brought before governors and kings “for a testimony against them and the Gentiles”, it is not we who speak but the Spirit of our Father speaking in us. The wicked who hides as an angel of light is revealed and condemned, because the witnesses must testify first before God brings forth judgment, as in a court of law.

precepts.label: Isaiah 47:12
precepts.why:
Babylon's destruction comes “in a moment in one day”, and the Lord gives the reason: “for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.” There was sorcery used upon our people in America, and then America used that same thing on all the nations.

That is why your uncle and your auntie won't repent after you accepted Christianity. That is witchcraft, used to keep you in the state of mind you are in. It is the pattern of every captivity: from the Assyrian captivity to the Babylonian, from the Medes and the Persians to the Greeks and to Rome, and now we are in America. All the nations have always used enchantments and witchcraft against us to keep us in darkness, and Satan is dealing with them.

The word enchantment means magic, witchcraft, sorcery, wizardry, necromancy, conjuration, hypnotism, mesmerism, voodoo, charms, spells, incantations, mojo. Remember coming out of Egypt, when the magicians were doing their things? Those magicians are who call themselves scientists today, with different titles under that name. They are the witches of this earth. Hypnotism is like the movie Get Out: our people have been sinking, and it is time to help them come out. America did not use only words against us. It used every witchcraft and every voodoo it could find, and the Catholic church is part of that foolishness.

Then the Lord dares them: “Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” America has been dealing with the devil from its youth up. “If so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.” The Lord is saying: since you have practiced these things from your youth, let me see if you will prevail against me. Let me see if that little nuke, that robot that is half a man, all that witchcraft and all the media you have through the earth, can stop what I am bringing into this earth.

We saw it when America was trying to attack and the Lord raised up a storm that destroyed helicopters and airplanes. They don't understand the prophecy. These things are already written, and no man can change them. The nuclear weapons every nation holds are not going to sit on a shelf like extra paint; an ICBM can reach Washington in under half an hour, and what Isaiah and Jeremiah spoke of exists in our time.

That is why we are out here teaching and telling our people to repent. We see what is coming. The same way God destroyed the first world with a flood, he is going to destroy this world with fire, and no sorcery or weapon can stop what God has written.

precepts.why:
The Lord told Jeremiah, “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.” God sent Jeremiah with a purpose. But Jeremiah felt he was too young, that it was not the time: “Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.”

The Lord did not accept Jeremiah's excuse: “Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.” That is a commandment. So do not doubt yourself, and do not let Satan take the prize from you. Maybe it feels like too much work; just do it. Put the Lord's house before your own, and speak what we are commanded: Christ is a black man, sent to the twelve tribes of the house of Israel.
